description: Find PubChem bioassays associated with a biological target. Search by gene symbol (e.g. "EGFR"), protein name, NCBI Gene ID, or UniProt accession. Returns a page of assay IDs (AIDs) — page past maxResults with offset — which can be explored further with pubchem_get_summary.

maxResults.description: Max AIDs to return per page. The per-call cap is 200: a larger value (up to 1000) returns a page of 200 and is reported in cappedInputs. Popular targets may have thousands of assays; use offset to reach the ones past this page. Default: 50.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first AID to return. Pass the nextOffset from a previous call to read the following page. Default: 0.

targetQuery.description: Target identifier. Examples: "EGFR" (genesymbol), "Epidermal growth factor receptor" (proteinname), "1956" (geneid), "P00533" (proteinaccession; uppercased before lookup, except a PDB chain ID such as the "A" in "1ZHH_A", which is kept as given).

targetType.description: Target identifier type. "genesymbol" and "proteinname" accept text names; a genesymbol matches the symbol case-insensitively across species, so a human symbol also returns assays on other species' orthologs. "geneid" accepts NCBI Gene IDs. "proteinaccession" accepts UniProt accessions. "geneid" and "proteinaccession" each pin one protein, but return overlapping, different assay sets for it, since PubChem records some assays under only one of the two identifiers; for a complete list for one protein, union both.

name: pubchem_search_assays

cap.description: The page size applied: maxResults, or the per-call cap when maxResults exceeds it.

cappedInputs.description: Inputs that asked for more than their per-call cap, with the value requested and the value served. An ID batch lists the IDs past the cap in unprocessed. Omitted when every input was within its cap.

items.description: One input served at its per-call cap.

requested.description: Value requested: the page size, or the number of IDs in the batch.

unprocessed.description: ID batches only: IDs past the cap, listed in unprocessed in input order.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `blank_target_query`: targetQuery is empty or whitespace-only. `invalid_geneid_query`: targetType is "geneid" but targetQuery contains characters other than digits. `target_query_rejected`: PubChem refused the target lookup with HTTP 400 — its answer for a targetQuery carrying a line break, another C0 control character other than tab and NUL, or DEL. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass on the next call to continue past this page. Omitted when no further AIDs match.

notice.description: Recovery guidance when no assays matched, when the offset runs past the result set, or when further pages remain. Absent when this page is complete and non-empty.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first AID returned.

targetType.description: Target identifier type used: genesymbol, proteinname, geneid, or proteinaccession.

totalFound.description: Total AIDs found for this target, across all pages.

truncated.description: True when matching AIDs remain past this page.

title: Search Assays
